title: How Nuclear Missile Officers Eat & Sleep 60 Feet Underground
intro: Two officers ride an elevator 60 feet under the Montana prairie and lock themselves behind an eight-ton door for 24 hours. Here's how missileers eat, sleep and stay sane.
asof_line: Figures from the US Air Force and the National Park Service; current details as of 2026.
